html:
For people, you can turn your head to the position and angle where you hear most clearly, to make the most of the signal you want. Whether that can be trained probably varies from person to person.

For machines, such as voice pickup in robots and smart speakers, the problem splits into two parts: capture and analysis. For capture, several microphones are usually fitted to form a microphone array, which enhances the signal from the direction of the target speech while suppressing background or interfering sounds (noise and so on) from other directions, raising the signal-to-noise ratio of the captured speech. I don’t know much about the speech analysis part, so I won’t answer that.
